record.question: What is the name of the world's fastest bullet train that is tested by Japan recently?
record.explanation: Answer C: ALFA-X. ALFA-X is the name of JR East’s next-generation Shinkansen test train, tested in Japan from 2019. Reference: https://www.jreast.co.jp/e/press/2018/20180702.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
